name: Jiggler Keys (cabinet / furniture)
description: Jiggler keys are a set of generic try keys with varied cut profiles designed for wafer-lock furniture, cabinets, desk drawers, and low-security padlocks. They are rocked and jiggled in the keyway while light tension is applied, mimicking the action of the correct key. File cabinet jigglers are particularly valuable on engagements where office floor access has been achieved and a file cabinet warrants attention.

blue.det: Key insertion and manipulation at cabinet lock; time at cabinet; camera coverage of area.
blue.cm: Replace wafer lock furniture with electronic access or high-security pin tumbler locks; sensitive documents in security containers with restricted key access.
